title: Affine Anosov Maps on $\mathbb{R}^n$: Classification, Index Spectrum, and Stability at Infinity
summary: For $n\ge2$, we classify the affine diffeomorphisms $f_{A,v}(x)=Ax+v$ on $\mathbb R^n$ that admit a complete Riemannian metric with respect to which they are Anosov. Such a metric exists if and only if $A$ is hyperbolic or $f_{A,v}$ has no fixed point, equivalently $v\notin\operatorname{Im}(I-A)$. In the latter case, $f_{A,v}$ is smoothly conjugate to a translation when $\det A>0$ and to White's map times the identity when $\det A<0$. We also determine the possible stable indices.
